titulo_de: Der Chef, Herr Müller, ist nett
titulo_es: The boss, Mr. Müller, is nice.

texto: A position gives extra information about a name and is separated by commas: **Mein Chef, Herr Müller, ist sehr nett** (my boss, Mr. Müller, is very nice). The position has the same case as the name it explains.
If the position has article and the name is repeated in another case, the case of the main name is maintained: **Ich helfe meinem Chef, Herrn Müller** (I help my boss, Mr Müller).

In German, the position in plural or with its own name is put between comas, as in Spanish. Don't confuse her with the relative prayer: **Mein Chef, der nett ist** (my boss, who is nice) is relative. The position has no verb.

filas: Mein Chef, Herr Müller, ist nett.
Ich helfe meinem Chef, Herrn Müller.
